Album.title: Album
Album.description: Represents a collection of photos, which can optionally be client-side encrypted with a master password.

isEncrypted.description: Whether the album uses client-side zero-knowledge encryption

salt.description: Salt used to derive the cryptographic key from the album passphrase

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the album owner

Photo.title: Photo
Photo.description: Represents a photo stored either as unencrypted plain data or client-side encrypted ciphertext.

albumId.description: Identifier of the album this photo belongs to

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the photo owner

isEncrypted.description: Whether this photo's payload is client-side encrypted

iv.description: IV used for decryption, base64 encoded (only if isEncrypted is true)

salt.description: Salt used for decryption, base64 encoded (only if isEncrypted is true)

ciphertext.description: Client-side encrypted string containing the JSON representation of the decrypted fields (only if isEncrypted is true)

title.description: Title of the photo (only present if unencrypted)

description.description: Description of the photo (only present if unencrypted)

dataUrl.description: Optimized image base64 data URL (only present if unencrypted)

tags.description: Array of tags for this photo (only present if unencrypted)

/photos/{photoId}.description: Stores photos associated with user albums, supporting client-side encrypted payloads
